purpose: Additively clarify the H2C pre-execution counters so that the single synthetic shape-check forward disclosed in the frozen protocol is recorded truthfully and not confused with project-data inference. The frozen protocol is NOT rewritten.
what_the_synthetic_forward_was: A single forward pass of a freshly-constructed, UNTRAINED H2C model on a random synthetic tensor of shape (1,1,512,512), performed on CPU to verify the output spatial shape is (1,1,128,128) and that the frozen terminal-zero initialization yields spatially constant initial logits (measured max-min = 0.0).
